topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Employee handbook code of conduct; security sanctions now in POL-01 4.10; policy acknowledgments not yet collected
gap: Staff have not acknowledged the new policies
remediation: Collect signed acknowledgments at hire and annually (POL-05 4.2)

control_description: Board of Managers (3 members, chaired by the majority owner) is the governing body; it has never received a written security report
gap: No Board oversight of security; the Board is not independent of the owner
remediation: First written Qualified Individual report 2026-10-15 and annually each October (16 CFR 314.4(i)); security as a standing Board agenda item (POAM-019)

control_description: Qualified Individual designated in writing (2024-03); roles, reporting lines, and risk acceptance authority defined in POL-01 sections 3 and 4.4
Background checks at hire; annual security and FERPA training (96% completion); no security training for IT staff
gap: IT staff lack security-specific training; awareness content not updated since 2023
remediation: Annual IT security course; updated awareness content (POAM-020)

control_description: Policies and POA&M assign an owner to every control and remediation item; sanctions not yet applied in practice
gap: Accountability defined but not yet exercised
remediation: Monthly POA&M review with owners (POAM-027)

control_description: Device inventory in device management; SSP component inventory (P02); no data map of customer information; identity and cloud logs kept 30 to 90 days
gap: No data map; short log retention
remediation: Customer information data map (POAM-026); 1-year log retention (POAM-010)

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Five policies approved 2026-08-21; incident reporting line not yet communicated to staff
gap: Policies and the reporting rule not yet communicated
remediation: All-staff briefing and acknowledgments (POAM-018)

control_description: FERPA annual notice in the catalog; no published security contact; servicer contract has no incident notice terms
gap: Notice omits contractors as school officials; no external security contact
remediation: Update the FERPA notice; security contact on the website; servicer amendment (POAM-002)

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Security objectives and risk tolerance defined in POL-01 and the P01 risk framing
2026 risk assessment using NIST SP 800-30 Rev. 1, 33 risks (P01)
Fraud risks are in the 2026 register: refund redirection (R-005), fraudulent awards (R-030), and identity fraud in online enrollment (R-033)
POL-01 4.3 requires reassessment after material changes; no change process yet to flag them
gap: Material changes are not captured by a change process
remediation: Change procedure (POAM-015)

control_description: First independent control assessment 2026-07-27 to 2026-07-31 (P07); no ongoing monitoring
gap: No ongoing evaluation between annual assessments
remediation: Monthly POA&M review; quarterly program review (POAM-027)

control_description: 27 deficiencies tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; not yet reported to the Board
gap: Deficiencies not yet communicated to the governing body
remediation: Include the POA&M summary in the 2026-10-15 Board report (POAM-019)

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the SP 800-53B Moderate baseline, tailored to the Safeguards Rule (SSP, P02)
SSP documents 62 technology controls; 35 partially implemented and 12 planned
gap: Many general IT controls are partial or planned
remediation: Close POA&M items on schedule

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies approved 2026-08-21; supporting procedures (access, change, contingency) not yet written
gap: Procedures missing
remediation: Access and change procedures (2026-11-30); contingency plan (2026-12-31)

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Staff SSO with MFA; provider and endpoint encryption; servicer administrators without MFA; unencrypted aid exports; shared lab administrator password
gap: Servicer access without MFA and unencrypted exports (High)
remediation: Servicer MFA (POAM-001); remove exports (POAM-003); unique lab passwords (POAM-012)

control_description: Staff accounts provisioned in the identity provider from HR tickets; servicer creates its own FAMS accounts; adjuncts use local LMS accounts
evidence: Identity provider export; FAMS account list
gap: Accounts created outside the approval process
remediation: College approval for every servicer account; adjuncts in the identity provider (POAM-008)

control_description: Role-based SIS and FAMS access; admissions and advisors see all student records; 11 stale adjunct accounts found; no access reviews
gap: Excess access and late removal
remediation: Role redesign (POAM-009); semiannual reviews (POAM-008); contract-end feed (POAM-022)

control_description: Badge reader on the server closet; records room key held by 9 staff with no key log; SaaS and cloud data centers inherited from providers
gap: Records room access uncontrolled
remediation: Rekey, key log, and badge reader (P01 R-026)

control_description: Paper shredded by a certified vendor; retired drives wiped in-house without a record; no disposal schedule
gap: Drive wiping unrecorded; customer information never disposed of
remediation: Logged wiping; retention schedule and disposal run (POAM-021)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Campus firewall with separate staff, lab, and guest VLANs; VPN with MFA; lab-to-staff rules unreviewed since 2023
gap: Lab-to-staff firewall rules not reviewed
remediation: Review and tighten lab rules (P01 R-006)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS for all SaaS and cloud connections; aid spreadsheets emailed without enforced encryption; no data loss prevention
evidence: P07 SC-8 result; mail flow report
gap: Customer information leaves by unencrypted email
remediation: Enforced message encryption and data loss prevention rule (POAM-011)

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: Signature antivirus on all endpoints; alerts unmonitored; no EDR
gap: Detections are not seen by anyone
remediation: Managed EDR with 24x7 alerting (POAM-005)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: No vulnerability scan since 2025; no documented baseline for the firewall or cloud workloads
gap: No vulnerability management
remediation: Scans every six months; annual penetration test (POAM-013, POAM-014)

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: No security monitoring or log review
gap: Attacks would go unnoticed
remediation: Log reviews (POAM-010); managed detection (POAM-004)

control_description: POL-03 4.4 defines who determines notification events and breaches; not yet practiced
gap: Evaluation process untested
remediation: Tabletop exercise (POAM-017)

control_description: POL-03 and the ransomware runbook (P08) approved 2026-08-21; not tested or distributed
gap: Plan untested
remediation: Distribute binders; tabletop (POAM-016)

control_description: No contingency plan; cloud backups never restore-tested and not isolated
gap: Recovery unproven (P01 R-019, High)
remediation: Isolated immutable backups (POAM-006); restore tests and contingency plan (POAM-007)

control_description: No change management for SIS, FAMS, integration, or firewall changes
gap: Changes made directly in production
remediation: Change procedure and log per POL-01 4.11 (POAM-015)

control_description: BIA completed (P05); cyber insurance in place; no contingency plan
gap: No contingency plan
remediation: Contingency plan from the BIA (POAM-007)

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: SIS and LMS SOC 2 Type 2 reports reviewed 2026-08-14 (vendor-soc2-review.csv); FAMS report requested; servicer contract lacks safeguards
gap: FAMS and servicer not yet assessed; servicer contract gaps
remediation: FAMS SOC 2 review, servicer questionnaire and amendment (POAM-002)
